notes: kb/Work PB1113 (landed w1006a). Rule (cite.py --check 14.8.2.3.3 -> OK 2) a)-d)): a) numeric formal -> COMPUTE rules; b) index data item formal -> SET rules; c) ANY LENGTH formal -> its length is considered to match; d) otherwise MOVE rules. Every storage-less sender (numeric literal, arithmetic expression, boolean value) is described as the sender it is and asked ONE verdict, OoConformance.ContentValueMismatch, in rule 2's order; the identifier lane (ContentMismatch) asks 2b before 2a and lets 2c relax LENGTH only.
